name: My Doki Doki SNAFU
source:
A mod of Doki Doki Literature Club, that follows a re-envisioned MC as he joins the Literature Club and spends the semester learning more about its members while trying not to get caught up in their antics. 

[Description sampled from the official reddit post:https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/skf0i2/my_doki_doki_snafu_full_release/]
